'''Maurizio''' is a male NPC who appears at Trattoria Margherita on [[Bank Street]], talking to Michele from 6:00 PM to 8:59 PM.

''(To Be Added)

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Maurizio:''' Here are the ingredients you ordered. Do a run down and I just need you to sign here when you're ready.
:'''Michele:''' Giovanni's the one that usually handles our deliveries. How come he's not here today?
:'''Maurizio:''' Don't get me started. Giovanni got nailed in the back by a Tumbleyak at the ranch. Takes him forever to even get off the bed.
:'''Maurizio:''' Weird, the animals at Egla Ranch have gotten really frantic lately.
:'''Maurizio:''' Speaking of him, it just hit me—doesn't Rosemary's potion work really well for injuries?
:'''Michele:''' That's true.
:'''Maurizio:''' But I've heard she's a [[Fisalia Family|Fisalia]]...
:'''Michele:''' That's also true.
:'''Maurizio:''' Ha, no wonder Giovanni didn't want to go see her by himself and wanted me to tag along...
:'''Michele:''' Don't worry. You have no reason to fear her. Rosemary is really nice, and not everyone from the Fisalia family is bad.
{{Dialogue End}}
